data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis): [cross_task_interference] CRITICAL: check-antipattern-scan-trailer.sh is registered globally at the commit-msg stage (task-3), so it fires on EVERY commit in the repo. It MUST early-exit 0 unless the .fix-bug-active marker (task-5a / 315a) is present — mirroring check-sprint-trailer.sh's 2-condition gate. Without this, once task-3 registers the hook it will reject all ordinary commits (sprint, docs, and the very commits building this feature) for lacking an Antipattern-Scan trailer. Marker-presence is the enforcement-scoping precondition.
